title: Buffer Overflow in aether_get_cwd
potential_fix: Add a check `if (len == 0) return 0;` before calculating `to_copy`. If `len` is 0, `len - 1` wraps around to MAX_USIZE, causing a buffer overflow.

title: Buffer Overflow in aether_get_tty
potential_fix: Add a check `if (len == 0) return 0;` before calculating `to_copy`. If `len` is 0, `len - 1` wraps around to MAX_USIZE, causing a buffer overflow.

title: Uninitialized Memory Access in Grid Resize Error Handling
potential_fix: Track the number of successfully initialized rows using a counter (e.g., `initialized_rows`). In the `errdefer` block, only iterate and `deinit()` the rows up to `initialized_rows`. The current implementation calls `deinit()` on uninitialized/garbage memory if `Row.init` fails mid-loop.

title: Zombie Processes due to Missing waitpid
potential_fix: Implement a signal handler for `SIGCHLD` or a dedicated reaper thread that calls `waitpid` on terminated child processes to prevent zombie processes accumulation.

title: Incomplete wcwidth Implementation
potential_fix: Replace the partial `wcwidth` implementation with a comprehensive one that covers all modern Unicode wide characters (e.g., using `libc`'s `wcwidth` if available and reliable, or a complete lookup table) to avoid rendering artifacts.

title: High Energy Consumption in Renderer
potential_fix: Implement logic to only trigger a redraw when the terminal content is dirty (`isDirty`) or when the cursor blink state actually changes (calculate the next toggle time). Avoid forcing a redraw every frame when idle.

title: Race Condition in Resize Logic
potential_fix: Synchronize viewport updates and grid resizing. Ensure that `viewportSize` updates in `mtkView` and background `resize` calls are coordinated (e.g., using the session lock for all state updates) to prevent `draw` from using a viewport size that mismatches the current grid dimensions.

title: Hardcoded Color Mapping Coupling
potential_fix: Decouple the renderer from specific ARGB values used in the Zig core. Expose palette indices (0-15) from the core `Cell` or provide an API to query the current default color values dynamically, ensuring themes work correctly even if core defaults change.
